acceptance_criteria.criterion: Webhook response timeout is configurable and bounded.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: HUNTER_ISSUE_AGENT_WEBHOOK_TIMEOUT_SECONDS is parsed as a positive finite value with a 1200-second hard ceiling.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: The production-safe default is aligned with synchronous governed execution.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: The default timeout is 900 seconds instead of the former fixed 30-second timeout.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Invalid timeout configuration fails closed before dispatch.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Empty, zero, negative, NaN, infinity, malformed, and over-limit values are rejected; focused regression tests cover these cases.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Existing endpoint and authorization security semantics remain unchanged.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: HTTPS-only endpoint validation, credential-free URL enforcement, redirect refusal, issuer signatures, and synchronous dispatch remain intact.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: The change remains scoped to the #441 transport-timeout blocker.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Only the trigger implementation and its focused tests change; #437 and #434 are not implemented here.

defect_families.evidence: Reviewed against the exact Issue #457 timeout-only candidate. The change preserves signed authorization semantics, HTTPS-only dispatch, redirect refusal, synchronous execution, and fail-closed handling while bounding and validating only the webhook response timeout.
